verdict.rationale: Docs claim self-hosting for privacy, offline chat models, and explicit Ollama integration (khoj-docs-6, khoj-docs-9, khoj-docs-38), but the story specifically names llama.cpp, LM Studio, and vLLM which are never mentioned anywhere in the evidence — only Ollama and the LiteLLM proxy are documented. Community reports (khoj-comm-10, khoj-comm-11, khoj-comm-12, khoj-comm-15) concretely contradict the 'fully offline/local' claim, stating that Khoj's chat feature historically required an OpenAI API key and routed data to ChatGPT despite marketing suggesting full local/offline operation. missing for 10: explicit llama.cpp support, explicit LM Studio support, explicit vLLM support, and independent confirmation that chat (not just search) runs fully offline with no cloud fallback.
